notes.title: ESCAPE Z - VERSION 1.0 AVAILABLE! 🎉
notes.notes:
After months of development, improvements and community feedback, Escape Z finally reaches its Version 1.0 and officially exits Early Access!
A major milestone that brings with it numerous new features, refinements, and a completely revamped visual identity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562314/36301babeac1959c9e3cea4b7875cc2623e6339e.png[/img]
✅ New official game logo
✅ New intro at the start of the game
✅ New song in the main menu
✅ Added the ability to purchase weapons found on the wall

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562314/096fa9f4a6d75b8e52bf910996553ae3f9d3bdf1.png[/img]
✅ Changed the backgrounds of some game screens.
✅ Changed the crosshairs for sniper rifles
✅ Changed the in-game score widget
✅ Changed the character reanimation icon
✅ Balanced and modified all vertical weapon recoils
✅ Increased the reload time for all weapons
✅ Increased the rate of fire for:
[list]
[*] Grenade launcher
[*] M890
[*] M1
[*] SKS
[*] SR S96
[*] Striker-12
[/list]
✅ Reduced the number of bullets in the magazine for:
[list]
[*] Grenade launcher
[*] M890
[*] SKS
[*] SCAR-H
[/list]

📌 With this release, Escape Z officially exits Early Access!
⚠️ There is also a slight price increase to reflect the content and improvements.

Thank you for your support and for accompanying the development to this point! 💪🧟‍♀️

notes.title: Approaching Version 1.0
notes.notes:
Development of [b]Escape Z[/b] is proceeding at full speed, and I am excited to share with you some updates on the status of the game and the release of version 1.0.

I am working hard to refine every aspect of the experience, balancing gameplay, optimizing performance, and adding the final details before the full release. [b]The release from Early Access is scheduled for 2025[/b], with new features, improvements, and content that will make Escape Z even more immersive.

Thank you for your support and feedback so far. Keep following us for more updates!

notes.title: Update on languages Escape Z
notes.notes:
In the next update, I am excited to announce the addition of three new languages to Escape Z: [b] Chinese, Dutch, and Greek[/b]. This represents the final step in my efforts to make the game accessible to a global audience.

[h2]Why these languages?[/h2]
I chose these languages based on community feedback and the goal of including regions of the world that are still underrepresented in the game. Each new translation has been carefully edited to ensure consistency and quality, with the support of experienced, native-speaking translators.

[h2]Latest round of translations[/h2]
With the addition of these languages, my work on internationalizing the game is officially complete. Escape Z now supports a wide range of languages covering multiple geographic areas, providing an increasingly inclusive experience.

[h2]A thank you to the community[/h2]
I could not have achieved this goal without your support and suggestions. Your passion has guided me every step of the way, and I am happy to have made Escape Z even more welcoming to players around the world.

Keep following me for more news: as I finish work on translations, new content and features are already under development. Stay tuned!

notes.title: UPDATE VERSION 0.8.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562314/096fa9f4a6d75b8e52bf910996553ae3f9d3bdf1.png[/img]
All the changes listed below are designed to balance gameplay and provide a more immersive experience by enhancing the unique characteristics of each weapon.

✅ [b]Striker-12[/b]:
[list]
[*] Increased maximum damage from 250 to 270, improving effectiveness in close combat.
[*] Increased reload time from 1.5 to 2 seconds, to balance the increased power.
[*] Increased the maximum vertical recoil from 0.5 to 0.9, making weapon control more challenging.
[*] Changed the reloading mode to improve the smoothness and realism of the animation.
[/list]

✅ [b]SR S96[/b]:
[list]
[*] Increased maximum damage from 550 to 700, providing devastating impact at long distances.
[*] Increased maximum ammunition from 15 to 20, providing greater range in combat.
[/list]

✅ [b]SCAR-H[/b]:
[list]
[*] Increased maximum damage from 90 to 110, improving its effectiveness in mid-range situations.
[/list]

✅ [b]Grenade launcher[/b]:
[list]
[*] Increased maximum damage from 600 to 800, to strengthen its role as a heavy area weapon.
[/list]

✅ [b]M890[/b]:
[list]
[*] Reduced maximum damage from 1000 to 650, for better balance compared to other weapons of similar category.
[/list]

✅ [b]M4A1[/b]:
[list]
[*] Reduced maximum damage from 200 to 180, to fit its role as a versatile weapon.
[*] Modified recoil, improving control and accuracy in extended shots.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: New Update - Old Factory + Turkish Language
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Survivors,[/h3]

I have some great news to share with you! I am working on a new map for "Escape Z" and I am excited to introduce you to [b]Old Factory[/b]. This new environment will take you to the heart of an abandoned industrial plant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562314/5bb28a37ec63f0b57f040e756b5c4994dbe5b760.png[/img]
[h2]Inspiration[/h2]
The [b]Old Factory[/b] will take you to a place filled with history and industrial decay. Rusty machinery, dark sheds and winding passageways create the perfect environment for a zombie apocalypse. I spent a lot of time designing a layout that balances open spaces and tight corners, offering a unique mix of exploration and danger.


[h2]Implementation of the Turkish Language[/h2]
I am happy to announce that, in the next update, it will support the Turkish language! With this addition, I hope to reach an even wider audience and make the game experience accessible to more players.


[h3]Thank you for your continued support and for being part of this exciting phase of development. Stay tuned for further updates![/h3]

notes.title: New Map Update - The Castle
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Survivors,[/h3]

I am excited to share some great news with you: I am working on a new map, and I am happy to present it to you - welcome to the "Castle"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562314/a1667d8f2039823eb615a40ec2d4125cf79d49e1.png[/img]
[h2]Medieval Inspiration:[/h2]
The decision to create a map set in a castle was fuelled by a passion for the medieval and mysterious atmosphere. I tried to capture the essence of an ancient fortress, full of secrets and challenges.


[h2]Next Steps:[/h2]
As I work hard on this map, I want to assure you that I will keep the community updated on any progress. I hope to implement the "Castle" in the next update, and I look forward to seeing how you find yourself in this new environment.


[h2]Abandoned City Map Removal?[/h2]
I am considering the removal of the Abandoned City map due to the fact that it is too large, compromising the pace of play and cohesion of the action. As well as the unbalanced nature of such a map. Some areas of 'Abandoned City' were too difficult or too easy, creating an imbalance in the gaming experience.


[h3]Thank you for your continued support and for being part of this exciting phase of development. Stay tuned for further updates![/h3]

notes.title: Development of Version 0.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Survivors,[/h3]

I wanted to share with you the excitement surrounding the development of the upcoming Version 0.1 of Escape Z. My commitment is to make this game experience even more immersive and enriching, and there are some new features that I am looking forward to introducing:

[h2]New Features; Activatable Traps:[/h2]
I am working hard to introduce a completely new tactical element-activatable traps. This will allow you to activate strategic traps to escape zombies more intelligently. Whether it's fire traps that burn zombies or electrical devices that disorient them, I want to provide you with new tools to deal with the apocalypse.

[h2]Support for Portuguese:[/h2]
I have listened to your requests and am excited to announce the addition of full Portuguese language support. Now you can experience the zombie adventure with an accurate and engaging translation in your native language.

[h2]Interactions and Feedback:[/h2]
Your feedback has always been crucial. During the development of this version, I am taking your suggestions and requests into account. I want "Escape Z" to be an experience that reflects your expectations and wishes.

[h2]Community Involvement:[/h2]
I will continue to involve you through social channels and game forums. Please share your ideas and experiences. Your participation is critical to the growth and evolution of the game.

[h3]Thank you for being part of this adventure with me. Version 0.1 is an exciting step forward, and I look forward to sharing it with you. And I take this opportunity to wish you all a happy holiday season![/h3]
